Proposition
[Algebraic limits lie in geometric limits] 1. 9.1.5\group thurston.ch09.convergenceSource: thurston:page-0244 If $\rho _i\to \rho $ algebraically and $\rho _i(\Gamma )\to \Gamma '$ geometrically, then $\rho (\Gamma )\subseteq \Gamma '$.
Proof

\sketch Pointwise convergence supplies, for each element of $\rho (\Gamma )$, a convergent sequence of elements of the image groups; apply the first clause of geometric convergence.

□
